summary.headline: Astrological Questions and Configurations
summary.text: Astrological chapters on theft, war and victory, treaties, Hermes’ herbs of the twelve signs and seven planets, Hermes Trismegistus’ iatromathematics to Amon, travel, planting, treasure, pregnancy and fetal sex, and Valens’ distinctions of the twelve places, sign divisions, trines, squares, and hexagonal figures, with Florentine codex cross-references.
